selected_experiment.question: Inside isValidChar_UInt32, do the common substitute/make/whnf costs arise from one repeated method-transition edge or a small stable transition basis shared by both deep-list cases?

classification_rule.stable_edge_basis: same dominant parent->child edge in both cases, dominant edge count >= 100000, and top-5 edge coverage >= 80% in each case

post_result_policy.if_stable_edge_basis: compile chain separator and prospectively test the cheapest exact transformation at the dominant edge
post_result_policy.if_distributed_chain: compile obstruction against a single-edge explanation and reclose to a broader representation change

claim_boundary: Diagnostic call-edge attribution only. Method wrappers observe nesting but do not alter kernel semantics.
